duplicates.help: Keeping a product merges the others into it: their MAs, renewals, documents and aliases are attached to it, and the former names become aliases. A group in conflict has two products with an MA in the same country: merging keeps only one of the two MAs, so check first.

imports.title: Excel imports
imports.dropzone: Drag and drop the .xlsx workbook or click
imports.dryRun: Simulation: produce the report without changing anything
imports.dropzoneHint: Accepts, in this order: the Africa MA Dashboard, the GHPL register “0_REGISTRE AMM GHPL.xlsx”, then the manifest of filed scans “manifeste_scans_amm_gh.csv”.
imports.registryHelp: GHPL register: records are completed without overwriting anything (missing original number and date), a submitted dossier opens a “submitted” renewal, and pack sizes known only from the scans are created. Warnings report MAs that were not found and filed decisions more recent than the Dashboard.
imports.scansHelp: Filed scans: each main document of the filing is matched to its MA and its period. Missing renewals are created, reliable dates from the filing correct the record (unless that would bring the MA expiry forward: warning), and numbers only fill in blanks. The files themselves are then sent by the script “importer_scans_classement.py”.

addPage.productHelper: Choose a product from the catalog if it already exists; otherwise it will be created.

detail.cancelText: As if it had never been opened: the dossier, its documents, samples, messages and filing receipt go to the trash (an administrator can restore them), together with what opening it created (the planned renewal, or the MA record of the application). The country is notified. To keep a record of a renewal you give up, use “Withdraw” instead.
